reviews.review_description:
This is a game EVERYONE should pick up if they’re fans of flying games… This was originally developed for the Quest 1 so even if you previously owned it, it’s worth the rebuy.  It’s a pretty big leap between the 2 versions. I wasn’t even able to play the old game anymore cuz the graphics actually hurt my eyes after a while. Lots of motion sickness too. Now I’m back to playing the remastered version NON STOP (unless I’m playing UW 2 Gold of course lol). 
And if you’ve never played the original then this is a no brainer purchase. The store is so full of slop these days, it’s nice seeing a couple quality titles drop on the same day, especially since I wasn’t expecting the devs to revisit these games in any form.   
Do yourself a favor and pick these underrated gems up. You won’t be sorry.

So happy that you guys remade your two Ultrawings games, only found out today but immedialty bought it and I'm so happy with it. These two games are probably my all time favourite VR games.

Here is hoping for Ultrawings 3!
